item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Troubleshooting#

If your screen became gray and you can’t click anything: On the bottom you can see a message “Your session timed out. click OK to log in again”. Don’t worry, click OK. You either need to log in again or just be redirected to main page.

Subscription is syncing too long: If your subscription is syncing too long - don’t worry, more likely it is active right now and you can use it. If it is not, contact IT department of Innopolis University.
